label: rare: first copy-phase feedback step (recall_idx 1), first token in {3,z,h,b}
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never on original inputs or the <DEL> step. 86% of activation mass sits at recall_idx 1 (step L+1, where the input is the fed-back first original token and the model outputs orig(1)); the other 14% is at recall_idx 2. Within that step it prefers a first token of 3, z, h or b (3 alone holds about 40% of the mass), and an output or next output of h, 1, 2, p, 3 or z. It also likes sequences with many digits and longer L. Even so the feature is very sparse: it fires on only about 0.3% of recall_idx-1 steps, and no simple combination of token conditions gives precision above about 10% (best dev F1 about 0.14). The recorded predicate covers about 62% of the mass at roughly 1.7% precision, so what decides firing inside this context is still unexplained. Magnitude is somewhat higher when the first token is 3 or z, and higher for longer L.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev2_tok=<DEL> (+3.53), recall_idx=1 (+3.50), prev_tok=<DEL> (+3.50), orig1=h (+3.11), recall_idx=2 & in_tok=3 (+3.00), orig2=p (+2.97). Lower it: n_digits=0 (-3.49), orig4=0 (-3.16), orig5=0 (-2.84), n_digits=1 (-2.57).
